installCommand: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
ignoreCommand: p="${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}"; git cat-file -e "$p^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || exit 1; git diff --quiet "$p" HEAD -- engine vercel.json ':(exclude)engine/docs' ':(exclude)engine/stress-oracle' ':(exclude)engine/*.md'
